description: Implement main.py (CLI orchestrator with argparse, banner, progress display) and update the root README.md to reflect Super Monster v2. Wire everything together so python -m super_monster works end-to-end.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/super_monster/main.py (~400 lines): CLI orchestrator using argparse. Subcommands: 'scan' (main command - classify, scan, verify, correlate, report). Arguments: --target (single domain), --scope (file with domain list), --output/-o (output dir, default ./results), --dry-run (no network, show what would be done), --threads (default 5), --timeout (default 10), --verbose/-v. Flow: 1) Print banner. 2) Load targets from --target or --scope file. 3) Call DomainClassifier to classify all domains. 4) Print classification summary. 5) Call SmartScanner for each domain (parallel). 6) Call Verifier on all raw findings. 7) Call SmartCorrelator on verified findings. 8) Call Reporter to generate output. 9) Print final summary with timing. Also support 'analyze' subcommand that reads existing monster_output JSON files and re-analyzes them through the v2 verification pipeline. Banner should show 'SUPER MONSTER v2.0 - Elite Bug Bounty Intelligence' with colorama styling.

Update /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/README.md: Change the Super Monster section (tool #3) to describe v2. Update description to 'Elite adaptive scanner with inline verification - zero false positives'. Update highlights to mention: adaptive per-domain-type scanning, inline verification (no false positives), real attack chain correlation, fast (30-60 min for 47 domains), honest reporting (no fake bounty estimates). Update usage examples to show: python -m super_monster scan --target example.com, python -m super_monster scan --scope targets.txt -o ./results, python -m super_monster scan --target payment.tw.coupang.com --dry-run. Update the project structure section to show the new v2 file layout.
acceptance_criteria: python -m super_monster --help shows scan and analyze subcommands with all arguments
python -m super_monster scan --target example.com --dry-run runs without errors and shows classification + test plan without making network requests
python -m super_monster scan --scope targets.txt --dry-run works with a file input
Banner displays 'SUPER MONSTER v2.0' with version info
README.md Super Monster section reflects v2 with accurate description and usage examples
Output directory is created when -o specified
Scan timing is displayed at the end
